title: Dynamic models with $p$ parameters are identified by $2p+1$ random features
summary: A foundational principle in nonlinear dynamics is that the structure of a dynamical system can be recovered from a small number of generic measurements or coordinates. We develop an analogous principle for the identification of dynamic models for time series \textit{with noise}, which builds on previous identification results for noiseless dynamical systems. The noise is allowed to be non-iid, non-Gaussian, and dependent on the state. Our results cover noisily observed differential equations and discrete-time dynamical systems, as well as stochastic models with process noise. We illustrate…
